title: BlockeraProductDetails
description: Schema for details about Blockera products.

name.description: Public name of the Blockera product.

description.description: A short summary of the product's purpose.

slug.description: Unique identifier for the product. if it is a plugin, it should be the plugin slug. if it is a theme, it should be the theme slug.

version.description: Version of the product, semver if possible.

isCompanion.description: Whether the product is a companion plugin.

author.description: Author or company responsible for the product.

homepage.description: Public homepage for the Blockera product.

assets.description: Various asset URLs relevant to the product.

dependencies.description: Other Blockera or WP plugins/themes required.

meta.description: Additional custom meta for the product.
